vectors.title: On allow, the host asks to wake exactly the held work item for the message
When waking fails, the send still succeeds and the message stays held
When waking fails, the sender gets a system notice that refers to its message
The Dispatch profile's failed-wake notice names the target and the host's reason

messages.body: Could not wake task:t-000003: task is blocked. Your message is waiting for it.

vectors.title: A wake notice for a sender session that has ended goes to that session's work item
On deny, the message stays held and nothing is woken
On deny, the sender gets a system notice that refers to its message
The Dispatch profile's denied-wake notice says waking the target was not allowed

messages.body: Waking task:t-000003 was not allowed. Your message is waiting for it.

vectors.title: A held message whose first line is as large as the body cap still raises a wake gate, whose quote the Dispatch profile cuts to 79 code points and an ellipsis
The wake policy is not asked about a recipient with a live session, nor about a message that requests no wake
An ask ruling raises a wake gate; approving it wakes the target before the answer is published
A human's wake request to an ended session holds the mail on that session and asks to wake exactly it
When the host cannot continue the ended session, the human sender gets a notice
The Dispatch profile's notice about an ended session that cannot continue names the host's reason

messages.body: Could not wake run:r-00000a: run has been merged. Your message is waiting for it.
